etymology.historical_story: One documented bearer is John Bosco, an Italian priest who devoted his life to educating young people and founded the Salesian Congregation. This explains an important cultural association of the name, not the provenance of this corpus token. Separately, Italian bosco means woodland; that foreign meaning is not automatically a Malay sense. [Vatican](https://www.vaticanstate.va/en/component/content/article/31-january-saint-john-bosco.html?Itemid=216&catid=51), [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/bosco_res-897badfe-adb2-11eb-94e0-00271042e8d9/).
